title: Black Cat
summary: Black Cat / Portable Trusted Linux has now physically retested the corrected M13B no-typing System Check on real hardware. After non-fatal ACPI AE_NOT_FOUND firmware messages, the machine reached BLACK CAT - QUICK CHECK without intervention. The photographed corrected run no longer shows the previous /run/blackcat quick-check Permission denied regression and reports UEFI, Secure Boot enabled, TPM device found, TCG event log found, dm-verity NOT_ACTIVE as expected before M17, no active network link observed, kernel 6.12.107+deb13-amd64 and x86_64. This remains OBSERVED evidence rather than attestation. M13B stays current only because the quick-check screen does not yet display internal-disk mount state; one read-only block-device/mount observation remains the next human gate. The exact candidate identity remains frozen below. AI autonomy, compact recovery and the future fail-closed M26 project-automation scaffold remain repository-governed and unchanged in authority.

sections.title: Automation Manifesto — proceed by default
sections.content: Black Cat engineering proceeds automatically through safe, reversible, auditable, already-authorized work. Human interruption is reserved for physical hardware interaction, destructive or difficult-to-reverse actions, platform/trust-ownership changes, new credentials or authorization, secret exposure risk, financial/legal/public-release commitments, material security-policy choices, or essential information that genuinely cannot be derived safely.

sections.title: AI autonomy policy — when GPT continues automatically
sections.content: AI_AUTONOMY_POLICY.md at the repository root is the canonical operational decision table. AUTO actions proceed without routine confirmation. AUTO_WITH_CHECKS actions proceed when their stated safety/regression checks pass. HUMAN_GATE actions stop for the operator, including physical/destructive device work, trust-ownership changes, new credentials/permissions, merges to main, approved-release promotion, new Internet-facing services and material security-policy choices. FORBIDDEN_BY_DEFAULT actions include secret exposure and weakening security gates for convenience. Missing tool capability is a capability boundary rather than a policy approval requirement.

sections.title: Recoverable AI chat continuity and context health
sections.content: AI_WORK_STATE.md is the compact first-read recovery checkpoint for fresh sessions or uncertain continuity. Ordinary continuing turns do not bulk-load repository history. Recovery verifies only volatile branch/CI/artifact facts required for the next action and loads policy, technical and lesson files selectively. Context pressure is never presented as an exact hidden ChatGPT context percentage; GREEN/AMBER/RED is a heuristic based on observable proxies. AMBER/RED checkpointing is automatic work, not a human gate.

sections.title: Future native AI project automation in Black Cat Linux
sections.content: After M25, planned M26 turns the repository-governed automation pattern into a native Black Cat user-space project facility. The checked-in templates/ai-project and schema/ai-project-policy.schema.json preserve a fail-closed design with HUMAN_GATE defaults, no root/raw-device/credential access, network disabled and no inbound listener. Runtime enforcement remains future M26 work.

sections.title: Physical System Check result
sections.content: The corrected M13B candidate has now physically reached BLACK CAT - QUICK CHECK on real hardware. Non-fatal ACPI AE_NOT_FOUND firmware messages appeared first but boot continued. The photographed corrected screen no longer shows the old Permission denied report-write errors and reports UEFI, Secure Boot ENABLED, TPM DEVICE_FOUND, TCG event log FOUND, dm-verity root NOT_ACTIVE, no active network link observed, kernel 6.12.107+deb13-amd64 and x86_64. This is OBSERVED evidence, not attestation. Internal-disk mount state is not shown on this screen and remains the only physical M13B closure check.

sections.title: Duplicate diagnostic execution fix
sections.content: blackcat-check.service is the sole root-owned evidence producer. The corrected physical retest no longer shows the previous report-write Permission denied regression.

sections.title: Evidence classification
sections.content: The quick-check screen reports observations and does not become its own ultimate verifier. Secure Boot ENABLED is a firmware-state observation and does not prove the Black Cat chain is authenticated.

sections.title: Verified builder toolchain
sections.content: The remote Debian 13 builder has the declared live-build, xorriso, verity, UKI, signing and TPM tooling installed. It remains a builder rather than an attestation target.

sections.title: Immediate evidence gate
sections.content: M13B remains current. The report-permission fix has passed its physical screen test. The next and final M13B human gate is read-only: inspect block devices and mount points from the live shell and photograph the result so internal disks can be confirmed unmounted by default. Do not mount, repair or write any internal disk.

sections.title: Progressive hardening
sections.content: Prototype stages may temporarily use weaker controls to prove the workflow, but every such control must document its trust assumption, compromise path, temporary justification and stronger replacement.

sections.title: Mandatory lessons discipline
sections.content: Every meaningful session updates docs/07-lessons-learned.md and affected specifications or decisions. AI_WORK_STATE.md is refreshed when material handoff/context state changes, and project_content.json is always written last.

decisions.title: Reuse mature security components
decisions.text: Use Debian, UEFI Secure Boot, systemd UKI, TPM 2.0 and dm-verity rather than inventing replacement primitives.

decisions.title: Independent verification is mandatory
decisions.text: The target computer cannot be the sole authority deciding that its own measurements are trustworthy.

decisions.title: GitHub is the canonical development workspace

decisions.title: Community Compute Commons paused
decisions.text: The research remains preserved, but active implementation returns exclusively to the core trust chain until its initial acceptance gates pass.

decisions.title: Progressive hardening is mandatory
